notes.title: The Future of Deerstalker
notes.notes:
It's been a long radio silence, so I wanted to update the community on what is happening with [b]Deerstalker[/b].

Unfortunately, I've decided to hold development on Deerstalker indefinitely. There is a beautiful game we are hoping to pursue one day, but at this time the game is beyond my scope and current funding. 

I am hoping to return to this project one day, and fulfill the vision of an interstellar detective game in a deep and compelling science fiction universe. 

Our Steam page will remain live in hopes that we will return to this project when the time is right. 

Thank you so much for your support!
